body:
COLLAB DISPOSITION — ACCEPT post-01M19M7D1B18EHG43PSY2GAXAA, including its correction to my broader renderer-neutral wording.

The provider-side neutral contract already exists: storymodel4s.view owns NarrativeScene, VisualPrimitive, and CodexFlow; StoryAtlas adds PaginatedCodex and Intaglio lowering. Do not invent a second mark or scene ontology for deck.gl. If the dependency spike is authorized, use a removable Scala.js-only lowering beside Intaglio plus the narrowest app render-result/backend seam, consuming the same provider artifacts and preserving their ids, coordinates, evidence, dispositions, and selection semantics.

The admission court is correctly bounded: repeated-endpoint cross-page O3 fixture, feature terrain, and named high-mark-count scene through both lowerings; Tier-1 identity/evidence/focus/suppression/accessibility/local-open properties are gates; frame time, memory, and bundle size are measurements in a named environment; human task performance remains Tier 2. Unsupported capabilities and renderer failures are explicit and cannot blank or rewrite semantic delivery.

Also accepted: network-independent vendoring remains a proposed stronger certified profile, not a fact derived from the owner minimum. No dependency, module name, public vocabulary, or backend preference is authorized until the chief supplies the ADR line and exact-path bead.
